Messages.Author: Tim Eijpe
Messages.Body:
Hi all,

First of all, hope you are enjoying your sabbat war. This came up after
reading the excellent rulebook. There is in no way any mention of the
NRA rule. Now is it *only* a tournament rule, and not part of the VTES
rules. Now I can understand a couple of reasons for not including this
in the rules, as there seem to be no cards in SW where the NRA would
apply. still it is an important ruling/rule. what's the deal.
Furthermore kudos to WW for mentioning this forum in the booklet!

Tim

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <8ubg8k$dem$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,

Tim Eijpe <t_e...@my-deja.com> wrote:
> Hi all,
>
> First of all, hope you are enjoying your sabbat war. This came up
after
> reading the excellent rulebook. There is in no way any mention of the
> NRA rule. Now is it *only* a tournament rule, and not part of the VTES
> rules.

It has always been only a tournament rule - it has never been a part
of the base rules. (Note: it is only a *constructed* tournament rule,
it doesn't apply to limited tournaments like sealed and draft).

--
LSJ (vte...@white-wolf.com) VTES Net.Rep for White Wolf, Inc.
Links to revised rulebook, rulings, errata, and tournament rules:
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/

True enough -- not many people realized that NRA didn't apply to
draft/sealed. But it's not like this is a recent rules change, just
an obscure existing rule that's been given wider dissemination.

on anyone's alertness -- I'll be the first to agree the thing was
pretty obscure) could have exploited it in the past.

Also, neither Majesty nor Freak Drive is in Sabbat War (which
I would think will account for most of the sealed tournament
activity at least for a while). In fact, the only offensive
(useful on your own turn) untap in Sabbat War is Patronage,
and that's limited to one a turn by card text.

And even in VTES/Jyhad sealed/draft tournaments, there are
usually few enough Majesties, Freak Drives, etc (in my
experience) that they're not very abusable via repeating
actions anyway.

Josh

Well, except maybe Patronage, (1 pool, +1 stealth !Tories only,
untap a younger !Tory and this !Tory, 1 per turn) which is kind of a 1 pool
clan based freak drive that you can block. (Affectionately called "Group
Hug" in our playgroup.) Hardly broken, but it does allow repeat actions.
